tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// tshigs su bcad pa gong 'og gnyis bzhugs// ༄༅// smras pa/ cung zad dben na rgyan po du ma 'gyed// bag tsam rnyed na kha la mchod par 'gyur// 'ga' zhig mthong na tshig ngan sna tshogs smra// rgyu mtshan chung ngus 'khrug long du ma byed// rang gzhan rgyud rnams me ltar sreg par brtson// de la smras na khong nas rab tu 'khrug /glang chen myos pa lcags kyu med 'dra ba// grol ba gzhon nu rang la chags pa khyed// rgyal ba bye ba phrag brgyas bskor gyur kyang*// rjes su 'dzin pa'i nus pa yod re skan// //yang smras pa/ brgya tshar mnyan pas tshig tsam shes pa can// mang du bshad pas 'don pa goms pa po// legs par gtugs na bla ma dbang byed pa'i// mkhas pa 'di dag chu shing snying po 'dra// sgra dang tshad ma de bzhin sdeb sbyor dang*// snyan ngag zlos gar dang ni tshig gi rgyan// ming gi nges brjod dus sbyor dpe spel ba// legs rtogs byang phyogs 'di na kho bo tsam// kwa ye smra rnams phyogs yid ring spongs dang*// shes bya 'di kun shes pa lta zhog gi /gang gi bstan bcos ji ltar yod pa yang*// sngon chad khyod kyi blo la yod re skan// mkhas pa mkhas pa'i grangs su bgrang ba la// gang gi phyogs tsam shes pa'i skye bo des// mkhas pa'i mdun sar mkhas zhes rlom mi bya/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
